items.title: Designing for compromise: security architecture for mission-critical systems
items.summary: Imagine two mission-critical systems exchanging sensitive data, when either system, or the network between them, could be compromised. We’ll build a secure integration architecture step by step, challenging common assumptions about trust, and introducing trust boundaries, identities, access control, data minimisation, encryption, and other security controls that limit blast radius.Using practical examples from defence technology, we'll explore how layered architectural decisions help contain attacks, protect critical data, and keep systems operational even when individual security controls fail.
